claims: The final round of the 2026 Masters is on Sunday, April 12.
CBS airs final round coverage of the 2026 Masters from 2:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. ET.
Paramount+ provides streaming coverage of the 2026 Masters final round from 10:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. ET.
Masters.com provides streaming coverage of the 2026 Masters final round from 10:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. ET.
Featured Groups coverage of the 2026 Masters is available from 10:15 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. ET on Paramount+, Masters App, and Prime Video.
Amen Corner coverage of the 2026 Masters is available from 11:45 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. ET on Paramount+, Masters App, and Prime Video.
Holes 15 & 16 coverage of the 2026 Masters is available from 11:45 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. ET on Paramount+, Masters App, and Prime Video.
Early coverage of the 2026 Masters includes Featured Groups at 10:15 a.m. ET on Paramount+, ESPN App, and Prime Video.
Early coverage of the 2026 Masters includes Amen Corner at 11:45 a.m. ET on Paramount+, ESPN App, and Prime Video.
Masters.com offers free coverage of featured groups and holes.
The Masters App offers free coverage of featured groups and holes.
CBS coverage can be watched through YouTube TV.
CBS coverage can be watched through DirecTV Stream.
A Premium subscription is needed to stream the CBS simulcast on Paramount+.
The CBS simulcast on Paramount+ begins at 12 p.m. ET for early coverage.
